candidates.name: Benson-Claugherty Contracting
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage service list includes 'Bathroom Partitions and Accessories' under Specialty Items, alongside casework, millwork, doors and frames.
candidates.reason: DBE/MBE/SBE certified commercial carpentry contractor in Maplewood (about 10 miles from the center) that lists bathroom partitions and accessories among its services. No project photos or brands could be read, so ask for partition references during vetting.
red_flags: Gallery and services pages returned no readable project detail; no partition project photos seen
Specialty items are a side line to carpentry, doors and hardware

candidates.name: Bartley Sales Co
candidates.base_city: St. Louis Park (site address reads Minneapolis, MN 55426)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage: Division 10 distributor since 1928 that 'also offers product installation if you require a turnkey service'; Toilet Compartments page lists six manufacturers but doesn't mention installation itself.
candidates.reason: Established Division 10 distributor that sells toilet compartments (including Bobrick and Bradley) and offers installation of its products, but partition installation isn't shown specifically. As a direct seller of the same brands, it's a big risk of buying around us.
red_flags: Distributor that sells toilet partitions itself (Bobrick, Bradley, Scranton and others): high buy-around risk
